description: This file contains logging utility functions for the lighttpd server, including initialization, cleanup, and message writing with timestamp support.

methods.name: void li_log_init(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Initializes the logging subsystem for the server, setting default log levels and creating string buffers for timestamps and logs.

methods.name: void li_log_clean(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for timestamp cache and log line buffers.

methods.name: void li_log_write(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,const gchar * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes a log message at a specified level, optionally prepending a timestamp, and outputs it to stderr.

methods.name: void li_log_split_lines(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,gchar * txt,const gchar * prefix)
methods.description: Splits a text buffer into separate lines and logs each line with a given prefix.

methods.name: void li_log_split_lines_(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,gchar * txt,const gchar * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats a prefix using variadic arguments and then splits and logs the lines.
